chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, de plusieurs de nos compagnons, de Sahl ibn Ziyad, d'Ibn Mahbub, d'Ibn Ri'ab, de Zurara, d'Abu Ja'far (que la paix soit sur lui), qui a dit :

Sualtu-hu ‘an rajulin qatala rajulan ‘ushran fi shahrin haramin, faqala: Tadghamu ‘alayhi ad-diyatu, wa-‘alayhi ‘atqu ‘abdin aw siyamu shahrayin mutabayidayni min ash-huri sh-shuruf. Qultu: Wa lakin shay’an yadkhulu fi dhalika [ya’ni fi siyami sh-shahrayi]. Qala: Wa ma huwa? Qultu: Yaum al-‘Idi wa ayyamu at-tashriqi. Qala: Yasiimu, li-anna-ha haqqun istawajaba ‘alayhi, wa-la yunaqidu al-haditha al-awala, li-anna al-nahya la tahtawu illa man bada’a as-siyama [tatawwu’an]; wa-amma idha istawajaba ‘alayhi shahrayin mutabayidayni ‘ala ma yadullu ‘alayhi al-hadithu, fa-hadhihi al-ayyamu mustawjaba lahu as-siyamu li-anna-hu dakhala nafsahu fi dhalika [al-wujub].
ai.seo_question: La mort accidentelle pendant le mois sacré nécessite-t-elle un jeûne pendant les jours de Tachriq ?
